scene_summary: A dark bark-framed woodland plate opens onto a moonlit pastoral valley. The usable source windows are carried by a torn left proscenium edge, a pale triangular siding-like fracture, a turquoise basin aperture on the right, small house-face chips, fence/gate cuts, slatted roof gestures, and compressed flecks near the lower path.
usable_surfaces: pale triangular gable fracture across center-right
turquoise rounded basin cut in right hillside
small pale house wall chip at lower-left
compressed moss fleck on lower path

detected_objects.label: hero bark proscenium aperture
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The dominant opening between the two black bark trunks forms an irregular proscenium around the moonlit hills, branches, gate, path, and small house; its contour follows the actual torn tree-edge aperture rather than the full image frame.

detected_objects.label: hero backyard render fracture
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A pale green-gray triangular fracture cuts diagonally through the center-right woodland, reading as a siding or rendered plane laid over the brush and hill contour.

detected_objects.label: primary video thumbnail glint
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The bright turquoise rounded aperture on the right hillside has glassy horizontal water-like streaks and a hard varnished edge, distinct from the surrounding dark vegetation.

detected_objects.label: pale resource chip
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A small pale rectangular house-wall face with tiny dark window marks sits near the lower-left opening, functioning as the visible label-like chip.

detected_objects.label: pergola animation notch
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The conical slatted roof form at lower-right creates a dense roofline notch with repeated dark ribs and hard triangular shadow cuts.

detected_objects.label: Agent Tool Reliquary
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The central gate opening and its dark rail-grid read as a muted web-surface plane, bounded by posts and crossed by small horizontal and diagonal marks without readable text.

detected_objects.label: thumbnail moss fleck
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A compressed ochre lattice-fleck embedded in the muddy lower path stands out as a small image-like color fragment near the bottom edge.

detected_objects.label: thumbnail moss fleck

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate is expressionist and image-led, with a strong bark aperture and a few clear source pockets, but the dense twig network adds visual noise around the central mapped surfaces.

mapping_note: Package assembly filled unmapped source pockets from planned artifact surfaces because plate inspection returned too few detected objects.
